name: Basil

schedule.notes: Wait — basil collapses at 50 F. Hard to recover.
Pinch flower buds religiously. Cut stems above a leaf pair to branch out.

harvest.cues: Leaves are bright green, no flowers. Strip whole stems when plant is 6+ in tall.
harvest.storageNotes: Stems in water on the counter (not the fridge — chill damage). Freeze pureed in olive oil for winter.

varieties.name: Genovese
varieties.notes: Classic pesto basil. Large smooth leaves.

varieties.name: Thai
varieties.notes: Anise-clove flavor, sturdy in heat, purple stems.

varieties.name: Purple Ruffles
varieties.notes: Deep purple frilly leaves. Striking, but slower-growing.

notes: Plant heavily — you need a lot for pesto. Successions help; downy mildew kills late-summer crops in humid regions. Look for DMR (downy mildew resistant) genetics.
